architecture/module-organization.description: AONIK is organized by business module with a vertical-slice feel.

architecture/overview.description: AONIK follows Clean Architecture with a modular, vertical-slice layout.

contributing/code-style.title: Code Style
contributing/code-style.description: AONIK follows the conventions described in AGENTS.md.

database/entity-relationships.title: Entity Relationships
database/entity-relationships.description: Entity relationships are defined using EF Core configurations in the Infrastructure layer.

database/schema-overview.title: Schema Overview
database/schema-overview.description: AONIK uses EF Core to map domain entities to a SQL Server schema.

database/tenant-isolation.description: AONIK supports multi-tenancy using ITenantScoped and EF Core query filters.

decisions/README.description: This directory contains Architecture Decision Records documenting significant architectural and design decisions made in the AONIK project.

deployment/azure-deployment.title: Azure Deployment
deployment/azure-deployment.description: This guide is a starter outline for deploying AONIK to Azure. It will evolve as the platform stabilizes.

deployment/docker.title: Docker Setup
deployment/docker.description: This repository does not include a Dockerfile for the services, but it does use Docker indirectly via .NET Aspire to provision infrastructure dependencies (notably SQL Server) for local development.

deployment/local-development.title: Local Development
deployment/local-development.description: This guide covers local development workflows for AONIK, including how the database is configured in different environments.

features/ai-integration.title: AI Integration
features/ai-integration.description: AONIK includes AI-related abstractions and provider implementations.

features/authentication-authorization.title: Authentication & Authorization
features/authentication-authorization.description: AONIK uses a modern authentication and authorization system that separates who you are (authentication) from what you can do (authorization).

features/billing.title: Billing
features/billing.description: The Billing module provides invoicing primitives and related workflows.

features/ledger.title: Ledger
features/ledger.description: The Ledger module models double-entry accounting concepts.

features/payments.title: Payments
features/payments.description: The Payments module covers payment intents, payments, refunds, payouts, and chargebacks.

guides/api-endpoints.title: API Endpoints
guides/api-endpoints.description: AONIK uses FastEndpoints for HTTP endpoints.

guides/authentication-auth0.title: Auth0 Setup Guide
guides/authentication-auth0.description: This guide walks you through configuring Auth0 as the identity provider for AONIK. Auth0 is a flexible authentication service that supports multiple identity sources (Google, GitHub, Microsoft, etc.) with minimal setup.

guides/authentication-azure-ad.title: Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID) Setup Guide
guides/authentication-azure-ad.description: This guide walks you through configuring Azure Active Directory (now called Microsoft Entra ID) as the identity provider for AONIK.

guides/authentication-troubleshooting.title: Authentication Troubleshooting Guide
guides/authentication-troubleshooting.description: This guide helps you diagnose and fix common authentication and authorization issues in AONIK.

guides/database-migrations.title: Database Migrations
guides/database-migrations.description: AONIK uses EF Core migrations from the Infrastructure project.

guides/domain-entities.title: Domain Entities
guides/domain-entities.description: AONIK uses an anemic domain model.

guides/getting-started.title: Getting Started
guides/getting-started.description: This guide gets you running locally with either Aspire (recommended) or a standalone API.

guides/roles-and-permissions.title: Managing Roles and Permissions
guides/roles-and-permissions.description: This guide explains how to manage roles and assign permissions to users in AONIK. This is for tenant administrators who need to control what users can do within their tenant.

guides/testing.title: Testing
guides/testing.description: This guide points to the canonical testing documentation.

index.title: AONIK Documentation
index.description: Build, integrate, and operate the AONIK platform with confidence. These docs give engineers a clear picture of the architecture, core modules, and the day-to-day workflows needed to ship features and keep services healthy.

patterns/dto-mapping.title: DTO Mapping
patterns/dto-mapping.description: AONIK keeps transport models and persistence models separate.

patterns/service-layer.title: Service Layer Patterns
patterns/service-layer.description: AONIK uses application services as the home for business logic.

README.title: AONIK Documentation
README.description: Welcome to the AONIK documentation! This guide will help you understand, develop, and deploy the AONIK financial infrastructure platform.

reference/permissions.title: Permissions Reference
reference/permissions.description: This document lists all permissions in the AONIK system. Permissions are global (not tenant-specific) and define specific actions users can perform.

SwaggerAuthentication.title: Swagger OAuth2 Authentication Configuration Guide
SwaggerAuthentication.description: This guide explains how to configure Swagger UI to authenticate with your OAuth2 provider (Azure AD or Auth0) in the AONIK API.

Testing.title: Testing Guide
Testing.description: This document provides guidelines and best practices for writing and running tests in the AONIK project.

Troubleshooting.description: Common issues and solutions for the AONIK project.
